overview: Dental implants are artificial tooth roots made of biocompatible materials like titanium, surgically placed into the jawbone to support a replacement tooth, bridge, or denture.
overviewImageAlt: Dental implant placed in the jawbone supporting a crown
reasons: Have one or more missing teeth
Want a long-term, stable replacement option
Wish to prevent bone loss in the jaw
Seek a natural look and feel for replacement teeth

procedure.title: Initial Consultation
procedure.description: A thorough dental examination and X-rays to assess your suitability for implants.

procedure.title: Implant Placement
procedure.description: The titanium implant is surgically placed into the jawbone under local anesthesia.

procedure.title: Healing Period
procedure.description: The implant integrates with the bone over a few months (osseointegration).

procedure.title: Abutment and Crown Placement
procedure.description: A connector (abutment) and custom-made crown are attached to the implant.

whyChooseUs: Focus on patient comfort and care

faqs.question: Are dental implants painful?
faqs.answer: The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, minimizing discomfort. Post-surgery, mild pain or swelling can be managed with prescribed medication.

faqs.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime.

faqs.question: Can anyone get dental implants?
faqs.answer: Most people with good oral health and sufficient jawbone density are candidates for implants. However, certain conditions may require additional evaluation or preparation.

faqs.question: Are dental implants safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, dental implants are a safe and widely used dental procedure with a high success rate.
